title: Red Seal Welder in Canada: Apprenticeship, Hours and the Exam
excerpt: How to become a Red Seal welder in Canada: apprenticeship hours in Ontario, Alberta and BC, what is on the 125-question exam, and how a Red Seal differs from a CWB ticket.

seoDesc: Become a Red Seal welder in Canada: Ontario 456A hours, Alberta and BC apprenticeships, the 125-question exam (70% pass) and CWB ticket vs Red Seal.
